family=review_round10
apis=62.0 67.0
native_complete=true
source=fresh Developer scratch orgs, one per capture run, deleted after the run
payloads=OBS lines from the USER_DEBUG log, the uncaught exception (the row's error column) or the test failure message; Salesforce ids masked
repeats=two clean runs; rows identical
raw_runs=review12/out/20261117T120723Z and 20261117T121126Z (capture cache, not committed)
shapes=add on the key set of a Map<Id,SObject> in anonymous code, through a class method and inside an @IsTest method (directly and through a class); add and remove on the key set of getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(); remove on a Map<Id,SObject> key set; add, remove, clear and clone().add on the key set of Schema.getGlobalDescribe(), with the size and containsKey of that map and of a fresh getGlobalDescribe() afterwards
notes=add on any of these key sets raises the uncatchable System.FinalException: Collection is read-only, and a test reports that type and message as its failure. remove on a Map<Id,SObject> or populated-fields key set writes through (1 to 0; 2 to 1, Name gone). On the global describe key set remove and clear write through to that map and not to a fresh getGlobalDescribe() (size and 'account' unchanged there); a clone of it is writable.
limits=the global describe write-through (g_gd_remove, g_gd_clear) is ledgered as a residual: Glade keeps remove and clear on that key set local to the Set. The counts of the global describe are environment values (about 1315 at 62.0, 1428 at 67.0), so the replay masks them to N and N-1.
